rights: Copyright Four Seasons Produce is printed on the PDF. No reusable licence or permission was established. Images retained only in the temporary retrieval artifact/local reference directory, not published as booklet replacements.

mango_orange.finding: The infographic shows a whole orange and sliced orange with a pink ring around the flesh. The owner-supplied AI collage panel showing a mango is not suitable and is rejected again. Owner clarification establishes the product identity, not approval of that incorrect image.

matching_boundary: Names are discovery leads, not automatic exact XML mappings. Supplier codes must never replace store PLUs. T'orange is labelled a lemon in this source; do not silently map it to an XML orange.
